name: nerium oleander leaf
uses: Uses For the temporary relief of symptoms of fever, associated with flu-like symptoms. Supports a healthy immune response.
otcwarn: Ask doctor Ask a doctor before use if you have been diagnosed with a heart arrhythmia are taking a cardiac glycoside. Stop use and ask a doctor Stop use and ask a doctor if symptoms persist for more than 7 days, worsen, or new symptoms occur
